title: Predictions as Surrogates: Revisiting Surrogate Outcomes in the Age of AI
one_line_what_it_does: Learns the optimal 'imputed loss' (recalibration) from labelled data by flexible ML with sample splitting; smallest asymptotic variance among PPI estimators; full text has 0 mentions of cluster/random effects (iid units).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Training/recalibrating the predictor on labelled data to minimise PPI variance (the generic 'inference-aware training' part of the claim); not clustered, no within/between.

title: Transfer Calibrated Prediction Powered Inference (TC-PPI)
authors: Aditya T. Vadlamani, Jae Ho Chang, Srini[...] et al. (listing truncated)
one_line_what_it_does: Adapts a source-domain predictor to the target using gold labels via cross-fitting (sparse linear calibration of embeddings, LoRA, fine-tuning); high-dimensional MSE bounds; jointly tuned estimator at least as efficient as classical/PPI/PPI++. iid units ('cluster' appears only as dataset units).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Shrink/adjust a source head with a small labelled set inside PPI with finite-sample theory = structure of 'between block shrunk toward within coefficient' with oracle-type bounds; applied at cluster-mean level it would instantiate the proposal.

title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Closed-form cluster-robust PPI++ sandwich SEs for fully/partially labelled clusters and cluster-aware power tuning; predictor f is fixed (no head training; text has no 'between-cluster', 'Mundlak', 'aggregate').
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Establishes the cluster-as-unit PPI variance and tuning; does not address predictor training or within/between conflation.

title: Learning from Aggregate responses: Instance Level versus Bag Level Loss Functions
one_line_what_it_does: Shows instance-level loss = bag-level loss + regulariser penalising within-bag variation of predictions; bias-variance comparison; interpolating estimator; precise risk in proportional asymptotics for linear regression.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Algebraic core of pooled-spot vs between-cluster training of a linear head and of interpolating between them; no PPI/inference estimand, no Mundlak floor.

title: Fixed Effects and the Generalized Mundlak Estimator
one_line_what_it_does: Group-level averages of unit variables as sufficient adjustment; Mundlak form with flexible functions of group means; causal (ATE).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Mundlak/group-mean features with flexible learners; no PPI, no predictor-head training.

title: Model-assisted analyses of cluster-randomized experiments
one_line_what_it_does: Design-based comparison of regression adjustment on individual data, cluster averages and cluster totals; cluster-level covariates drive efficiency; cluster-total regression recommended.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cluster-level regression adjustment whose variance depends on cluster-level aggregates (the whole-cluster identity); no learned heads.

title: Model-robust and efficient covariate adjustment for cluster-randomized experiments
one_line_what_it_does: Efficient estimator with ML-estimated nuisance functions using cluster- and individual-level covariates in CRTs.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Efficient cluster-level adjustment with ML nuisance; iid clusters; no between/within head.

title: A Hybrid GREG Estimator for Estimation in Cluster Sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Hybrid GREG between unit-level and cluster-level assisting models in cluster sampling; cluster-level model loses individual patterns and risks ecological fallacy; unit-level ignores design.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Survey-sampling statement of the unit-level vs cluster-level assisting-model trade-off (the ecological fallacy side of within/between).

title: Double Machine Learning meets Panel Data
one_line_what_it_does: Finds Mundlak (correlated random effects) based predictive models inside DML give accurate estimates under unobserved heterogeneity.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Precedent for using group-mean (between) features inside ML nuisance models; causal not PPI.

title: Prediction-Powered Inference with Imputed Covariates and Nonuniform Sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Predict-then-debias bootstrap CIs for weighted/stratified/clustered complete samples; predictor treated as given.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cluster-aware PPI; no predictor training.

title: Statistical Optimality of Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Efficient influence function; PPI attains semiparametric bound when predictor is score-calibrated; cross-fitting theory. No cluster content in text.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Optimal predictor characterisation (conditional expectation) = what a between-trained head approximates; iid.

title: Calibeating Prediction-Powered Inference
authors: van der Laan, van der Laan
one_line_what_it_does: Post-hoc linear/isotonic calibration of prediction score on labelled sample; linear calibration first-order equivalent to PPI++; isotonic gives efficiency gains.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Calibrating the predictor on labelled units to improve PPI efficiency; iid.

title: Prediction-Powered Inference Across Many Tasks for AI Evaluation & Social Science Research
one_line_what_it_does: Cross-task recalibration (GRE-PPI); proves affine recalibration of a scalar surrogate yields no gain beyond power tuning.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Pooling labels across related tasks to learn a recalibrator; relevant caveat that gains need richer (multi-dimensional) recalibration; no clusters.

title: Bias-Aware External-Model-Assisted Inference in High-Dimensional Regression (DEAL)
one_line_what_it_does: In linear models PPI's rectifier cancels the predictor so PPI reduces to OLS; proposes cross-fitted shrinkage of external estimator in debiased lasso.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Shrinkage toward an external coefficient in high-dim; shows linear-head PPI collapses to regression; iid.

title: Prediction-powered Inference by Mixture of Experts
one_line_what_it_does: Chooses mixture of predictors minimising PPI variance with best-expert guarantee and nonasymptotic coverage bounds.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Variance-minimising predictor combination; iid.

title: Multi-Source Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Aggregation weights of multiple pseudo-labelled sources chosen to minimise confidence-region volume; covariate/domain shift.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Variance-optimal predictor weighting; iid.

title: Estimate Level Adjustment For Inference With Proxies Under Random Distribution Shifts
one_line_what_it_does: Models proxy-vs-primary discrepancy as a random effect at the parameter level across domains.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Random-effects view of proxy bias across domains (clusters); no head training.

title: Learning Theory for Distribution Regression
one_line_what_it_does: Ridge regression from kernel mean embeddings of bags to outputs; consistency in two-stage sampled setting.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Distribution-regression machinery for the 'between block fitted on cluster mean embeddings'.

title: Kernel Mean Embedding of Instance-wise Predictions in Multiple Instance Regression
one_line_what_it_does: Instance-MIR averages instance predictions per bag; kernel-mean embedding extension.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Bag-level vs instance-level training of regressors (ML analogue).

title: Aggregating Data for Optimal and Private Learning
one_line_what_it_does: Optimal bagging for MIR/LLP with bag-level labels.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Learning from aggregated labels, no inference.

title: Transfer Learning for High-dimensional Linear Regression (Trans-Lasso)
one_line_what_it_does: Estimator transferring auxiliary-sample coefficients to target with debiasing step.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Shrinkage toward a source coefficient (within-cluster coefficient as source).

title: Transfer Learning with Random Coefficient Ridge Regression
one_line_what_it_does: Weighted sum of target and source ridge estimates; optimal weights via random matrix theory when p/n->gamma.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Ridge toward source with precise risk; closest to a Pi-metric shrinkage analysis but for prediction risk, not PPI variance.

title: Predicting with Proxies: Transfer Learning in High Dimension
one_line_what_it_does: Two-step estimator: proxy-trained coefficient plus sparse correction on small true data.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Same structure (proxy head + correction on small labelled set).

title: Efficient and Adaptive Linear Regression in Semi-Supervised Settings
one_line_what_it_does: Uses unlabelled covariate data to improve linear regression efficiency (EASE).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Use of label-free covariate geometry; iid.

title: Prediction-Powered Semi-Supervised Learning with Online Power Tuning
one_line_what_it_does: PPI-style unbiased gradient for model training with online tuning of interpolation parameter.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: PPI idea used inside training; not variance-minimising head for an estimand.

title: Conditional validity of prediction-powered inference for spatially dependent finite populations
one_line_what_it_does: Conditional validity of PPI with spatially dependent errors and nonuniform labelling.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Already listed prior art in brief.

title: Between- and Within-Cluster Covariate Effects in the Analysis of Clustered Data
one_line_what_it_does: Between vs within cluster covariate effects in clustered-data models (Crossref record only in session; content from background knowledge).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Between/within coefficient distinction (floor identity foundation).

title: On the Pooling of Time Series and Cross Section Data
one_line_what_it_does: Correlated random effects; group means as regressors (Crossref record only in session).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Within/between conflation in pooled regression.

title: Explaining Fixed Effects: Random Effects Modeling of Time-Series Cross-Sectional and Panel Data
one_line_what_it_does: Within/between decomposition in multilevel models (Crossref record only in session).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Between/within decomposition.

title: Unbiased Estimation of the Average Treatment Effect in Cluster-Randomized Experiments
one_line_what_it_does: Unbiased HT-type cluster-level estimators with covariate adjustment using cluster totals.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cluster-total adjustment.

title: Correlated random effects models with unbalanced panels
one_line_what_it_does: Mundlak/CRE with unbalanced panels (Crossref record only).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Mundlak CRE.

title: An Error-Components Model for Prediction of County Crop Areas Using Survey and Satellite Data
one_line_what_it_does: Unit-level nested-error model for small-area means (Crossref record only).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Unit-level vs area-level (Fay-Herriot) modelling in SAE.

title: A practical solution to pseudoreplication bias in single-cell studies
one_line_what_it_does: Pseudoreplication in cell-level analyses (Crossref record only).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Genomics analogue of unit vs cluster-level analysis.

title: HEST-1k: A Dataset for Spatial Transcriptomics and Histology Image Analysis
one_line_what_it_does: HEST-Benchmark of pathology foundation models (ridge heads on pooled spots).
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Source of the pooled-head practice.

title: Generation-Powered Inference for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
one_line_what_it_does: PPI-like inference for Wasserstein barycenters of single-cell perturbation outcomes.
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Adjacent genomics PPI; not clustered.
